3b1(mdo): 'das kyis de nyid kyi //rtse mo rin chen brgyand pa la //rgyal (ba'i) sras kyis yongs bskord cing //rdul myed chos ni bshad tu gsold //gang rnams lang kar gnas pa dang //bdag cag di ring nyan
3b2(mdo): par 'tshal //bshad pa'i tshul las rnam grol ba //so so rang rig spyod yul te //lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo sde ni //sangs rgya(ba) snga (ma)sa gsungs pa'o //rgyal pa'i sras kyis yongs bskord cang
3b3(mdo): sngon gyi sangs rgyas dag gyis kyang //mdo sde 'di ni bshad par dran //bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol //ma 'ongs dus na byung ba'i //sangs rgyas sangs rgyas sras dag kyang //lha'i tshul te
3b4(mdo): 'di nyid ni //rtse mo rin chen brgyan pa la //rnod sbyin rnams la thugs brtse'i phyir //'dren pa rnams ni stond par 'gyur //lha'i lang ka'i grong rdal 'di //mdangs dga' rin chen
3b5(mdo): sna tshogs dang //thel sdings rdo stegs dga' ba dang //rin chen 'dra ba'i bla res brgyand //rnal 'byord nyes dang rnam bral pa //so so rang rig snyems pa'i //bcom ldan 'di na gnod
3b6(mdo): sbyin dag //sangs rgyas snga mas mdzad srung pa //theg chen tshul la dad pa yis //mngon par zhend cing gzhan 'dzud pa //gnod sbyin mo dang gnod sbyin bu //theg chen rtogs par 'tshal pa mchis

3b8(mdo): rig nyan par 'tshal //sangs rgyas rnams la bgyi ba bgyis //da lta na yang shind tu bgyid //bdag la shind tu thugs brtse'i phyir //lang kar sras dang bcas te gshegs //
